description: This file appears to be a shell script used for testing the behavior of the 'git show' command with options related to expanding tabs in log output. It defines test functions that compare expected and actual output for different formatting options.

methods.name: count_expand
methods.description: Generates expected output with a combination of tabs and spaces based on input parameters and compares the output of 'git show -s' with expected formatted data.
